name: QuickBlox AI Agent
author: qbsmartchatassistant

sections.description:
QuickBlox AI Agent — AI Chatbot & Workflow Automation for WordPress

Answers questions. Collects leads. Books appointments. Hands over to humans when it matters.

QuickBlox AI Agent adds an AI-powered agent widget to your site that does more than chat. Train it on your own content to answer visitor questions instantly, or build multi-step workflows that qualify leads, collect information, and guide users to action — all without writing code.

Why QuickBlox AI Agent?

A chatbot that only answers questions is yesterday’s tool. Today’s visitors expect an agent that understands their intent, remembers context across the conversation, and actually moves things forward — whether that’s resolving a support query, capturing a lead, or scheduling a call.

QuickBlox AI Agent gives you two ways to do that:

Knowledge Agents — Train an agent on your website pages, FAQs, and documents. It answers visitor questions from your content, matching your brand’s tone, 24/7. Perfect for support automation and product Q&A.

Workflow Agents — Design multi-step conversation flows with a drag-and-drop builder. Your agent asks questions, collects and remembers information across the conversation, makes decisions based on user responses, and triggers actions — like lead qualification, appointment booking, intake forms, and onboarding.

  • Handles conversations 24/7 — no queues, no waiting
  • Automates support and reduces ticket volume
  • Qualifies and captures leads, even when your team is offline
  • Hands over to a human with full conversation context
  • Shows you what visitors actually ask through built-in analytics

Start your FREE trial today!

Key Features

  • Two agent types — knowledge-based Q&A agents or fully agentic workflow agents
  • Drag-and-drop workflow builder — design conversation logic with no code
  • AI trained on your content — upload pages, FAQs, docs, or your full site
  • Smart data collection — agents gather and reuse information across the conversation
  • Pre-built workflow templates — support triage, lead qualification, appointment booking, onboarding, product FAQs
  • Customizable widget — colors, placement, greetings, brand tone
  • Page-selective display — site-wide or targeted pages
  • Human handover — escalate complex conversations with full context transferred
  • Insights & analytics — see what customers ask and where conversations drop off

Need Healthcare Compliance?

Choose the HIPAA-compliant AI Agent for healthcare-grade privacy, PHI support, and a signed BAA. Built for clinics, telehealth, and medical SaaS.

What You Can Use It For

  • Support automation – Instant answers, fewer repetitive tickets.
  • Lead qualification – Agents ask the right questions and route high-intent leads.
  • Appointment booking – Visitors schedule without leaving the chat.
  • Patient/Client intake – Structured data collection, step by step.
  • Product onboarding – Users learn inside your app.
  • Sales enablement – Respond to objections in real time.

Quick Setup

  1. Create or log in to your QuickBlox account.
  2. Build your agent — train it on your content or design a workflow.
  3. Copy your Widget ID from the dashboard, paste it into WordPress → go live.

Setup takes minutes. Don’t have a QuickBlox account? Create one for free here!

Upgrading from SmartChat Assistant?

QuickBlox AI Agent is the evolution of SmartChat Assistant. Your existing widget, Widget ID, and knowledge base continue to work — no reconfiguration needed. You now also get access to the new workflow agent capabilities from the same dashboard.

External Services

This plugin uses an external service provided by QuickBlox to display an AI agent widget on your site.

What the service is and what it is used for: The plugin loads the QuickBlox AI Agent widget (JavaScript) from QuickBlox servers. This widget is needed to show the agent interface to your visitors and to handle conversations, AI responses, workflow execution, and optional human handover.

What data is sent and when: When a page that has the agent widget enabled is loaded, the plugin loads the widget script from QuickBlox. The script is requested using your configured Widget ID (App ID). Messages and other data entered by visitors in the chat are processed by QuickBlox in accordance with their terms and privacy policy. The plugin does not send data to QuickBlox until the site administrator has configured a Widget ID in the plugin settings.

QuickBlox service links:

  • Terms of Use: https://quickblox.com/terms-of-use/
  • Terms of Service: https://quickblox.com/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://quickblox.com/privacy-policy/

Useful links

  • Website: https://quickblox.com
  • Support: https://help.quickblox.com/
sections.installation:
QuickBlox AI Agent — Installation & Configuration Guide

This guide will walk you through installing, configuring, and using the QuickBlox AI Agent for WordPress.

This plugin adds an AI-powered agent widget to your site that does more than chat. Train it on your own content to answer visitor questions instantly, or build multi-step workflows that qualify leads, collect information, and guide users to action — all without writing code.

🔧 Plugin Installation

To get started with QuickBlox AI Agent on your WordPress site, follow these simple installation steps:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP archive or search for the plugin via Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Click Install Now and then click Activate after the installation is complete.

🧩 Plugin Settings Panel

Once activated, you will see a new menu item in your WordPress admin menu called QuickBlox AI Agent.

Navigate to QuickBlox AI Agent → Settings to configure the plugin.

📌 Required Setup

To connect the widget to your QuickBlox project and display it on your site, configure the following settings:

  • Widget ID: Enter your unique Widget ID copied from your QuickBlox dashboard. This is required to load and connect your custom agent.
  • Enable QuickBlox AI Agent on All Pages: Check this option to display the AI agent widget across your entire website.
  • Select a Specific Page: If you prefer a targeted approach, use the dropdown menu to choose exactly which pages your AI agent should appear on.

📝 QuickBlox Account Setup

An active QuickBlox account is required to power your agent. You can set it up directly through the plugin settings:

  • If you don’t have an account yet, you can create a new one directly from the plugin settings. You can select a standard plan or a HIPAA-compliant plan (designed for clinics, telehealth, and healthcare-grade privacy with a signed BAA) depending on your needs.
  • If you already have an account, click Log in to QuickBlox, build your agent (either a Q&A Knowledge Agent or a Workflow Agent), copy your Widget ID from the dashboard, and paste it into the plugin settings.

⏱️ Trial Notification and Expiration

When you first activate the plugin, a 30-day free trial period begins to let you test out all features:

  • You will see a notification banner in your WordPress admin dashboard showing how many days are remaining in your trial.
  • If you have already upgraded to a paid subscription, you can easily dismiss this notice.
  • If the trial period ends without an active subscription, the widget will become inactive on your website, and a notification will inform you that the trial has expired.
sections.faq:
Does it require coding?

No — install, paste your App ID, and you’re running.

Can I customize the look?

Yes — colors, welcome messages, placement, and more.

What content can it learn from?

FAQs, website pages, documents, help articles — your voice, your data.

Is it available for healthcare?

Yes. A HIPAA version with PHI support + BAA is available.

Can it hand off to a human?

Yes, you can route conversations to a support agent when needed.
